column4: cargo or the wasm32-wasip1 target is not installed on this runner, and this test needs a real Rust guest: it asserts that a guest side_effect function runs once across a first run and its replay (cleat#4113), which only running one can show. It runs and passes where the Rust toolchain is installed (the engine test-go job).
